name: Coherent Ising machine after a step of the pump
question: After a step that makes the collective state unstable, how long does the population take to leave it, and with what spread?
assumptions: all-to-all ferromagnetic coupling xi0/(N - 1), xi0 = 0.6, so the in-phase mode crosses its threshold at p* = 1 - xi0 for every N; m is the mean in-phase amplitude, the transverse modes are damped at xi0
the vacuum and pump noise (1/As) (c^2 + s^2 + 1/2)^(1/2) of each oscillator, averaged over N
As = 100 (g = 0.01 of Maruo, Utsunomiya and Yamamoto, Phys. Scr. 91, 083010, 2016)
the pump stepped from p* - 0.5 to p* + 0.4

provenance.source: Z. Wang, A. Marandi, K. Wen, R. L. Byer and Y. Yamamoto, Phys. Rev. A 88, 063853 (2013); normalized truncated-Wigner equations of Y. Haribara, S. Utsunomiya, K. Kawarabayashi and Y. Yamamoto, arXiv:1501.07030, eqs. (3), (4), (8)
